copy.title: App Toolkit on Google Play
copy.headline: Everyday tools to measure, signal and decide
copy.description: Google Play listing visuals for App Toolkit: Quick Tools with a live compass and level, the Measure tab with a ruler, protractor, unit converter and bill splitter, and Play & Decide with the Decision Wheel.

../listing/en-US/graphics/phone-screensh.title: App Toolkit: Handy tools, one tap away
../listing/en-US/graphics/phone-screensh.altText: Quick Tools with a live compass, bubble level, flashlight and SOS, grouped by sensors and light

../listing/en-US/graphics/phone-screensh.title: App Toolkit: Measure, count and convert
../listing/en-US/graphics/phone-screensh.altText: Measure tab with live previews of the ruler, protractor, unit converter, bill splitter and counter

../listing/en-US/graphics/phone-screensh.title: App Toolkit: Leave it to chance
../listing/en-US/graphics/phone-screensh.altText: Play & Decide tab with the Decision Wheel, a random number, a coin flip and a dice roll

../listing/en-US/graphics/phone-screensh.title: App Toolkit: Let the wheel decide
../listing/en-US/graphics/phone-screensh.altText: Decision Wheel sheet with four choices typed in and Sushi picked by the wheel

../listing/en-US/graphics/phone-screensh.title: App Toolkit: Measure angles on screen
../listing/en-US/graphics/phone-screensh.altText: Full-screen protractor reading 60 degrees, with the arm along the screen's edge

../listing/en-US/graphics/phone-screensh.title: App Toolkit: Split the bill, tip included
../listing/en-US/graphics/phone-screensh.altText: Tip and Bill Splitter sharing a 100 dollar bill and a 15 percent tip between four people

../listing/en-US/graphics/phone-screensh.title: App Toolkit: A tone for a wet speaker
../listing/en-US/graphics/phone-screensh.altText: Water Eject sheet ready to play a 30 second 165 Hz tone through the speaker

../listing/en-US/graphics/phone-screensh.title: App Toolkit: Signal SOS with the torch
../listing/en-US/graphics/phone-screensh.altText: Morse and SOS sheet ready to flash the SOS pattern with the flashlight
